verdict.rationale: Runway Ads automatically generates on-brand ads, publishes them to Meta, Google and TikTok, then builds the next round around what earned spend. That is a documented autonomous background loop, but only for ad campaigns. Workflows (node-graph pipelines published as versioned endpoints) and Recipes provide multi-step pipelines, but they are invoked on demand rather than set up to run autonomously, so the general story is only partly met. Missing for 10: general user-configurable automations, scheduling or event triggers for background runs, autonomous execution beyond the ads use case, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
